_comment: Copy to approved-mints.json. Nothing runs live until dryRun is explicitly set to false for a target. This file is your Risk-Committee-equivalent sign-off record — keep it under version control so changes are reviewable. Entries with a _verification block were drafted by the mint-intelligence agent from live research and still need a human to close out anything under _verification.unresolvedFields before they're trustworthy, let alone before dryRun ever goes false.

gogh-punks-robinhood._comment: Researched by mint-intelligence on 2026-08-13. See _verification below before using this for anything beyond a dry run.

trigger._comment: 2026-08-14 23:15 UTC per the project's announced mint time — reconfirm close to mint time, drop times shift often.

contractAddressSources: https://nftcalendar.io/event/gogh-punks-public-mi/ (displayed truncated there; full value cross-checked via the OpenSea API listing)
unresolvedFields: mintFunction/mintArgs — not confirmed against verified contract source; do not assume mint(uint256). Pull the real signature from the block explorer's verified-source tab (https://robinhoodchain.blockscout.com) once the contract is up, or from the project's own docs if published.

contractAddress — both sources found ultimately trace through OpenSea's listing data, which is not fully independent verification. Could not reach the project's own site (https://goghpunks.xyz/ failed to load) or confirm verified-contract status on the block explorer directly. Treat as a strong lead, not a confirmed address.
walletsToUse is intentionally empty — mint-intelligence never populates this; a human adds real wallet labels here.
_verification.notes: Robinhood Chain itself (chain ID 4663, RPC, explorer) is confirmed from Robinhood's own docs — high confidence. Mint schedule/price/supply/per-wallet-cap came from a drop-calendar aggregator (nftcalendar.io), which is reasonably reliable for logistics but not for a security-critical field like a contract address. Before this ever runs live: (1) open https://goghpunks.xyz/ yourself and confirm the contract address matches, (2) confirm the contract shows as verified on https://robinhoodchain.blockscout.com and pull the real mint function from its source, (3) only then consider flipping dryRun. This is exactly the kind of target where a fast, convincing secondary source (aggregator + marketplace listing) is not the same as verifying the project's own claim.
